title: simonlin1212/TradingAgents-astock

zh.gap: 中文散户内容压倒性地单向——所有内容都是买入理由。没有什么会例行地、用同等力度把反方立起来给你看。
zh.pain: 手里拿着 A 股、一只票能读到五种互相打架的说法、却没地方把空头理由和多头理由摆在一起看的散户。
zh.kill: 硬性完整性边界：这东西一旦被读成荐股引擎，就是在向散户卖投资建议，既受监管，也是伤到用户最快的路。框架自己的回测不构成它有效的证据。
zh.move: 只交付「分歧」，永远不交付结论：两栏，最强多头理由和最强空头理由各带出处，不给分、不给信号、不给仓位。自限为「只做翻译和摆开两边，决定是你的」。冷启动：中文＝雪球讨论区与小红书「A股 复盘」标签；英文＝r/investing 的 steelman-the-bear-case 讨论串。

pick_reason: The project offers a unique and specialized framework for A-share trading with potential for monetization through tailored analytics.
gap: Chinese retail investing content is overwhelmingly one-directional — everything is a reason to buy. Nothing routinely constructs and shows the opposing case with equal force.
pain: The retail A-share holder who reads five contradictory takes on one stock and has no way to see the bear case laid out against the bull case.
kill: Hard integrity boundary: the moment this reads as a recommendation engine it is selling investment advice to retail, which is both regulated and the fastest way to hurt the people using it. The framework's own backtests are not evidence it works.
move: Ship the disagreement, never the verdict: two columns, strongest bull case and strongest bear case with sources, and no score, no signal, no position. Self-limit to 'translate and lay out both sides, decisions are yours'. Cold start CN = 雪球/雪盈 讨论区与小红书「A股 复盘」标签; EN = r/investing 'steelman the bear case' threads.
